name: Local Control Constraint Conditional Incremental Source Test v1
changes: same v2 control extractor; add label-free facts for 599 unscanned source APKs; fit fixed auxiliary logistic readouts
feature_definition: four Role31 edge-level proof ratios: any observed call verified, all observed calls verified, any verified call with a dominating branch, and static bypass among verified edges; zero means no verified fact, never unguarded
coverage_definition: Role31 observed-edge mask and per-Role UNKNOWN fraction, plus global observed/frozen edge fraction and UNKNOWN event fraction
training: each fold uses all 639/640 outer-train APKs, not the global OOF routed subset; train/test hidden states come from the SAME frozen outer-fold model
model_selection: NONE; all auxiliary parameters and features fixed before target comparison. Outer-train hidden states are in-sample upstream representations, so they MUST NOT be used for inner hyperparameter search. Original C43 already used its own inner selection. Any later tuning requires inner upstream refits in a new version.
route: unchanged frozen SVM MeanOpposition Top25%; un-routed final probabilities remain Stage-I
conditional_shuffle: independent train/test donor permutations within outer-train-fitted P31 KMeans(4), same Stage-I predicted side, train-fitted median Host-count bin and median UNKNOWN-coverage bin; mask unavailable receiver Roles; label-free approximate matching, not an exact conditional randomization test
bootstrap_unit: APK; stratified by outer fold, label, route membership and Stage-I predicted side; paired resamples of frozen OOF predictions; conditional on the observed cohort and fitted models, not retraining or family-aware population inference
primary_interval_family: 10 differences: BA and two conditional AUCs for M2 versus M1, M3 repeat0, M4 repeat0, plus BA versus M0; Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile intervals plus ordinary paired 95% intervals
prohibited: exact API identity as classifier input
cross-fold hidden-coordinate concatenation as training data
global OOF route selection of auxiliary training rows
on_fail: stop and report controls, uncertainty and all failures; no automatic tuning or future runs
on_pass: permit a separately specified frozen diagnostic; do not change formal CARE-Droid
claim_boundary: verified method-local control structure is not runtime execution, consent, data purpose, benign evidence or causal malware explanation
